uncertain.note: The diacritic on ι could be smooth breathing + acute, or a circumflex (εἶς). Kept as εἴς.
The diacritic on ι of εἰ looks a bit like breathing + accent. Kept as εἰ.
Printed letterspaced as 'hrest' and 'hr-till', probably abbreviations of hvarest and hvartill. Kept as printed.
